name: Awakening Zone — the Spawn token's sacrifice ability is not granted to other permanents
notes: Seen in the sweep diff. 'Create a 0/1 … token. It has "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}."' gave that ability to every permanent. 'has "…"' right after a token is created defines the token and is skipped.
